seed_ledger.name: Salt River Project: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: Coronado Generating Station (822 MW): NO_DC_TIE and supply line not yet named. The coal-to-gas conversion needs a new lateral that a third-party gas supplier will permit and build, and the same lateral will also serve Salt River Project's Santan Unit 4. No sponsor or project is named yet and the filings cite general Arizona demand growth, not a data center. Marigold Energy Center (675 MW gas with solar and storage, Pinal County): NO_DC_TIE. Salt River Project says it has secured capacity on Energy Transfer's Desert Southwest expansion (already on the roster as P7840) but no source says this plant is tied to a data center or that Desert Southwest serves it. Company-wide statements say data centers are the fastest growing customer group, which is not a plant tie. Re-check when the third-party lateral sponsor is named in the Arizona Corporation Commission case. Searches run: 5. Sources checked: Salt River Project Coronado page (third-party lateral, no sponsor); Salt River Project Marigold page (no pipeline named); Power Engineering on Arizona fuel supply (Desert Southwest capacity, neither plant mentioned, no plant-level data center tie); trade and local press on Coronado and Marigold (general demand growth only).

evidence.note: third-party lateral to be built, no sponsor named
project page, no pipeline or data center named
Salt River Project capacity on Desert Southwest expansion; neither plant mentioned

seed_ledger.name: Basin Electric Power Cooperative: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: Bison Generation Station (1,490 MW, Williams County, North Dakota): gas comes by a new 24-inch lateral of about 16 to 17 miles built by WBI Energy (FERC docket CP26-158, Line Section 32 Project, 190,000 Dth/d, proposed), not on the roster. NO_DC_TIE: Basin Electric testified that data centers are not behind the plant, though it gets large-load requests, and the state commission found the same. A power plant lateral with no data center tie is monitor. Already recorded as monitor in earlier runs. Re-check if a WBI or Basin filing cites data centers. Searches run: 1 this run (plus earlier passes). Sources checked: North Dakota Monitor (Basin denies data center driver); North Dakota Public Service Commission case 25-0086 results (WBI lateral about 16 miles); earlier FERC scoping notice.

evidence.note: Basin says plant not driven by data centers
FERC notice for the WBI lateral, from earlier verified run
